name: Boosting Female Founders Initiative — Round 1 (AU, GO3792)
source: Department of Industry, Science and Resources — GrantConnect GO3792 (quoted verbatim from the analysis document provided by the customer 2026-09-07). Fund group: cross-industry, targeted at a demographic (women founders).

rules.title: Startup MAJORITY OWNED AND LED by women (>50%)
rules.quote: To be eligible you must: be a female founded (majority owned and led by women) startup; show evidence that your startup is a female founded (majority owned and led by women)

rules.title: Registered for GST
rules.quote: be registered for the Goods and Services Tax (GST)

rules.title: Eligible entity type
rules.quote: be one of the following entities: an entity incorporated in Australia; an incorporated trustee on behalf of a trust; an Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Corporation registered under the Corporations (Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander) Act 2006 (Cth); a partnership; a sole trader.

rules.title: Not an excluded entity (income tax exempt, unincorporated, trust, government body)
rules.quote: You are not eligible to apply if you are: income tax exempt; an unincorporated association; a trust (however, an incorporated trustee may apply on behalf of a trust); a Commonwealth, State, Territory or local government body (including government business enterprises)

rules.title: Grant $25,000–$480,000, up to 50% of eligible costs
rules.quote: Estimated Grant Value (AUD): From $25,000.00 to $480,000.00. The grant amount will be up to 50 per cent of eligible project costs
